prompt:
Create a high-fidelity landscape 1600x1000 desktop screenshot of GO Itaim Dashboard Geral, route Comparação, using the selected "Folhas de Operação" visual system. Warm ivory paper canvas, precise ruled panels, small yellow divider tabs, cobalt primary controls, charcoal typography and restrained clear-sheet surfaces. Match the supplied approved Visão Geral reference. No browser chrome, no device frame, no made-up features; preserve exact Portuguese product terms and GO Itaim identity.

Persistent left sidebar has exact navigation groups: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR, Comparação selected), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Top header breadcrumb "Principal › Comparação"; city update ticker centered: green refresh icon, "Sincronizado", clipped horizontal sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09" with fade edges to indicate scroll; right theme and profile. These city/date examples are mock placeholders.

Below header, show complete shared two-row dashboard filter: "Período", mode "Ano/Semana" selected and "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", selected multiple "Semana 05, 06, 07"; second row "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", "Limpar". Make these eight controls visually distinct, readable, and separate from the page-specific panel.

Main page includes a full-width paper panel with eyebrow "Comparativo", title "Comparativo semanal", helper "Análise bi-semanal de performance, crescimento e variação operacional.", an action "Apresentação", plus "Praça selecionada" select and "Janelas de tempo" with exactly two week chips, e.g. Semana 05 and Semana 06. Below show comparison content organized into clearly ruled sections: compact summary metrics, a clear weekly comparison chart or table, and an additional daily comparison table. Use a selected warm yellow tab to distinguish the chosen two weeks and blue for the other period. Add small real section controls "Metricas", "Detalhada", "Por dia", "Por origem", "UTR" only if space allows. Use only illustrative values. Preserve the full global filter and ticker above the content.
title: Folhas de Operação — Comparação
